name: cppl
description: C++L language support: diagnostics, navigation, canonical formatting, and syntax highlighting via cppl-lsp.

cppl.serverPath.description: Path to the cppl-lsp executable. Defaults to build/dev/bin/cppl-lsp relative to the workspace root, then to cppl-lsp on PATH.

cppl.clangPath.description: Clang driver executable cppl-lsp uses to preprocess and semantically check documents (forwarded as cppl-lsp --clang). Defaults to cppl-lsp's own default.

cppl.clangArguments.description: Extra arguments forwarded to Clang for every document (include paths, defines, -std=), forwarded as repeated cppl-lsp --clang-arg. They follow the flags the document's compile_commands.json entry gives it, which are read automatically.

cppl.serveCpp.description: Also serve ordinary C++ files (the cpp language) from cppl-lsp: diagnostics, navigation, completion, hover, outline and formatting. Off by default, because another C++ extension usually serves them and two servers on one file publish two sets of diagnostics. When it is on, turn that extension's IntelliSense off for the files cppl-lsp serves.

cppl.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and cppl-lsp.
